name: The Hand Assembly Line
prompt: Lay out robot hands in successive stages on an open factory floor. A pinch gripper lifts a pin, a finished hand threads a needle and an apprentice adjusts a thumb joint.

name: The Walking Crane Nursery
prompt: Assemble little walking cranes under a high gantry. One balances on a test rail while a finished pair carry their own spare legs toward the packing shed.

name: A Factory for Gentle Work
prompt: Build a robot works around test benches of fragile objects. Mechanical fingers lift eggs, fold lace and stack porcelain cups as inspectors adjust the spring tension.

name: The Robot Tailor
prompt: Send unfinished robots through a fitting hall. A gantry lowers work aprons and tool harnesses onto differently shaped bodies while mechanics hem a canvas sleeve beside the line.

name: The Returned Parts Orchard
prompt: Disassemble worn robots in a salvage court, grading brass eyes and elbow gears into open bins. New compact machines emerge at the opposite end carrying the emptied trays back.
